errors.text_span: линията бележи период на непрекъснато покачване в продължение на шест години
errors.evidence: From 2013 to 2019 is six years of data points, but the description counts them incorrectly as 'six years of continuous increase' when there are actually values for 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019 — which is indeed six data points after 2013, but the phrasing implies continuous uninterrupted growth for exactly six years. Looking at the data, from 2013 (4120) there is indeed continuous growth through 2019 (5980), which is 6 years of increases. This is actually correct, so this is not an error.
The description does not mention that the data comes from НСИ (National Statistical Institute), which is explicitly noted in the chart title and in the reference description.
